hosting: No default download URL is published. Supply the release bundle locally or an explicit HTTPS URL.
overlaps: natural-dev64 is a subset of natural1024; eight flat-tie entries share identical arrays. LibriSpeech natural and subword cohorts share 256 source recordings but have different emissions. Joined long clips use source recordings from the natural pool.
regeneration: The bundle manifest contains source IDs, transcript text, model and dataset revisions when originally pinned, inference settings, source-selection plans, and recorded exclusions. Regeneration on different software/hardware may change emissions; only this checked frozen bundle reproduces the published suite exactly.
